question: What is Abhinavagupta systematizing in the Tantraloka on the basis of this scriptural teaching?
premises: The Malinivijayottara presents a fourfold knowledge.
This fourfold knowledge brings the great rise of attainment and liberation.
Abhinavagupta states that he systematizes it in the Tantraloka.
inference: The Tantraloka is presented as a systematic exposition of the Malinivijayottara's fourfold knowledge leading to attainment and liberation.
uncertainties: The precise boundaries of the fourfold knowledge are assumed from context rather than spelled out here.
plain_english: On the basis of this very teaching in the Malinivijayottara, I systematize here in this work called the Tantraloka that fourfold knowledge which brings the great rise of attainment and liberation.
